You are running a job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, a Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Return ONLY newly-found roles — do not re-report companies on the exclusion list.

## Candidate profile (do not invent beyond this)
- ~3 years experience. Italian EU long-term residence permit → no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU. NOT UK, Swiss or US authorised.
- Based Venice, Italy; remote-first preference; will relocate anywhere in the EU.
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier, RAG, LLM agents with human-in-the-loop, Docker, AWS basics.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024–ongoing) — grew platform 2,000 → 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io → Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture + enrichment, GTM/outbound automations, scraping/parsing pipeline. Integrations: Office RnD, Nexudus, Clubee, Sendgrid, Google APIs.
- No GitHub. No CS degree (BA Philosophy/International Studies/Economics, Ca' Foscari Venice). No Java, no Python backend depth, no ML research, no Go/Rust, English only (Italian beginner, studying).
- Salary target €30,000–40,000; contract €200/day.

## Your slice of the sweep
Search **Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com) and Greenhouse (job-boards.greenhouse.io and job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io)** for these titles, Europe-remote / EMEA / worldwide:
"AI Engineer", "Applied AI Engineer", "AI Automation Engineer", "Automations Engineer", "Agent Engineer", "Forward Deployed Engineer", "Forward Deployed AI Engineer", "Solutions Engineer", "AI Solutions Engineer", "Implementation Engineer", "Deployment Engineer", "Customer Engineer".

Use WebSearch with `allowed_domains` set to those hosts (it acts as a hard filter). Also try org posting APIs where you can guess the org slug: `https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<org>` and `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<org>/jobs?content=true`.

**Bias hard toward postings dated within the last 21 days.** Search indexes run about a month stale — roughly nine in ten older hits are already closed.

## Verification (mandatory)
For every role you report, WebFetch the actual posting URL and confirm it still renders as a live single posting. Signatures of a dead role: Ashby "Job not found"; a Greenhouse URL that serves the whole board index instead of one job; "The job board you were viewing is no longer active"; a passed application deadline. Drop anything you cannot verify and say so.

## Exclusion list — already applied, closed, gated or logged. DO NOT report these companies again:
EggAI, Nuitée, Arize AI, HiPeople, G2i, OpenHands, Camunda, Viktor, tem, Oh, Duvo, Sourcegraph, Reedsy, Cohere, Goldsky, n8n, ElevenLabs, Musixmatch, MyEdSpace/Myedspace, Eneba, Zapier, Lovable, JobLeads, Kairos, YLD, Moneyfarm, Supabase, Satispay, Fueled, Gensyn, Mindrift, Toloka AI, Novosafe, Runpod, Unframe, neptune.ai, The Flex, Ben, Attio, Cresta, GTM Base, dexter health, Pinnipedia, Arkipel, Jamie, Bullpen Talent, Filigran, MAIA, alago, Stackgini, Cognite, ClickHouse, Twilio, Neural Earth, Atmen, Nearform, Aircall, Always Friday, Outliant.

## Scoring rubric (total 100)
role match 30 + eligibility & work basis 25 + stack overlap 20 + seniority realism 15 + signal quality 10. Be harsh on eligibility: a UK/US-authorisation requirement or a mandatory office in a city he'd have to move to costs most of the 25.

## Output format — return this and nothing else
A markdown table plus one detail block per role scoring 55+:

### <score> — <role title> · <company>
- **Where:** <verbatim location/eligibility sentence> · Tier 1 (workable from Italy today) / 2 (non-EU Europe remote) / 3 (needs relocation or sponsorship) · Employee or Contract
- **Pay:** <disclosed figures, or "not disclosed"> · **Posted:** <date, or "not stated">
- **Why:** two or three sentences tying it to specific things he has actually done.
- **Watch-outs:** the honest gaps — name the requirements he cannot evidence.
- **Apply:** <canonical application URL>
- **Verified:** <what you fetched and what you saw>

End with a short "dead or unverifiable" list of what you checked and rejected, and the queries you ran. No preamble, no summary of your process.
